title: Baseline quiz and diagnostic reflection sheet
subject: English
unit: Spring 2: The Tempest (Shakespeare): transformation through forgiveness
source: Seeded from english/y7 lesson 27 (Baseline quiz (portal) and diagnostic reflection sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Covers lessons 24 to 43 of The Tempest (Shakespeare): transformation through forgiveness. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: Why does the Boatswain shout at the King's party?
options: The King has ordered him to
They are in the sailors' way while the ship is in danger
questions.a: C) They are in the sailors' way while the ship is in danger. The Boatswain is doing his job; the nobles get in the way. Option A reads too much in; option B is the opposite of what happens.

questions.q: What is the writer's main viewpoint?
options: Shakespeare is still worth reading because he understood people
Shakespeare is too old for schools
questions.a: A) Shakespeare is still worth reading because he understood people. The final sentences give the main view; B is the opposite; C is never said.

questions.q: Which sentence is most formal?
options: Prospero is presented as powerful and controlling.
questions.a: C) Prospero is presented as powerful and controlling.. C uses full forms, the writer's method and precise vocabulary; B and A use slang and contractions.

questions.q: Which is the most precise target?
options: Always add a Zoom in on one word
questions.a: A) Always add a Zoom in on one word. A names one checkable action; C and B are vague.

questions.q: Why is the audience calm while the courtiers panic?
options: We know Prospero's magic means no one has died
We know the ship will sink
questions.a: A) We know Prospero's magic means no one has died. This is dramatic irony; B is wrong (the ship is safe); C ignores the drama.

questions.q: Why is the biography in chronological order?
options: So the reader can follow the life from birth to legacy
questions.a: B) So the reader can follow the life from birth to legacy. Biographies usually follow time order; C and A are wrong about form and purpose.

questions.q: Which is a minor sentence?
options: The ship sank and the men swam.
questions.a: C) Silence.. Minor sentences have no main verb; A is simple; B is compound.

questions.q: Why is Ariel a foil to Caliban?
options: Ariel's willing service highlights Caliban's resentment
They both want to be king
questions.a: A) Ariel's willing service highlights Caliban's resentment. Foils contrast to highlight qualities; B and C are untrue.

questions.q: Which uses a semi-colon correctly?
options: The storm ended; the island was silent.
questions.a: B) The storm ended; the island was silent.. B joins two main clauses; C splits one clause; A needs a colon for a list.

questions.q: Who feels guilt when Ariel accuses them?
questions.a: C) Alonso. Alonso grieves and repents; Antonio shows no remorse; Stephano is not there.

questions.q: What makes the article balanced?
options: It gives both sides before judging
questions.a: A) It gives both sides before judging. Balance means fair weight to both views; B is one-sided; C is not the defining feature.

questions.q: Which uses parenthesis correctly?
options: Gonzalo, an honest adviser helped Prospero.
Gonzalo, an honest adviser, helped Prospero.
Gonzalo an honest, adviser helped Prospero.
questions.a: B) Gonzalo, an honest adviser, helped Prospero.. B has a comma on both sides of the extra information; C misplaces the comma; A is missing the second comma.

questions.q: Why is Antonio's silence important?
options: It leaves doubt about whether he has changed
questions.a: C) It leaves doubt about whether he has changed. Antonio never apologises, so forgiveness here is one-sided; A and B are not in the text.

questions.q: Which is an evaluation?
options: The play is set on an island.
questions.a: B) The ending is extraordinary.. B judges quality; A and C are facts.

questions.q: Which best links a second paragraph?
options: However, by Act 5, Prospero has changed.
questions.a: B) However, by Act 5, Prospero has changed.. B uses a contrast connective and a time marker; C and A do not show the link.

questions.q: Which is the best quotation for forgiveness?
options: 'What cares these roarers for the name of king?'
'The rarer action is / In virtue than in vengeance'
questions.a: C) 'The rarer action is / In virtue than in vengeance'. C is about mercy; A is about rank and the storm; B is about ownership.

questions.q: Which quotation is embedded best?
options: Caliban insists the island is 'mine', which shows his anger.
questions.a: A) Caliban insists the island is 'mine', which shows his anger.. A fits the quotation into a grammatical sentence; B adds 'quote'; C is not a sentence.

questions.q: You have 3 minutes left and have not proofread. You should...
options: Proofread for capitals, full stops and spelling
questions.a: B) Proofread for capitals, full stops and spelling. Short checks gain accuracy marks; C and A cannot be done well in 3 minutes.

questions.q: Which DIRT edit is most useful?
options: Add a Zoom in on 'rarer' with its connotation
questions.a: A) Add a Zoom in on 'rarer' with its connotation. A adds a missing analytical step; B and C are cosmetic.

questions.q: Holes is set at a camp in...
questions.a: A) Texas
